events.text: The PBYs were adapted for aerial minelaying.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 1 January 1944 : The new year brought with it a change of duties for the squadron . The PBYs were adapted for aerial minelaying .

events.text: The squadron was consolidated at Funafuti for maintenance.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 1 February – 1 March 1944 : In February , the squadron was consolidated at Funafuti for maintenance

events.text: VP-72 was again split into detachments operating from Makin, Kwajalein and Eniwetok.
events.subject: self
events.quote: By 1 March 1944 , VP-72 was again split into detachments operating from Makin , Kwajalein and Eniwetok

events.text: VP-72 was consolidated at Ebeye Island.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 8 June 1944 : VP-72 was consolidated at Ebeye Island , with all aircraft and crews berthed ashore .

events.text: VP-72 was relieved by VP-18 for return to NAS Kaneohe Bay.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 17 July 1944 : VP-72 was relieved by VP-18 for return to NAS Kaneohe Bay

events.text: The squadron reached San Diego and all hands were granted 30-day rehabilitation leave.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 1 August 1944 : The squadron reached San Diego and all hands were granted 30-day rehabilitation leave .

events.text: The squadron was reformed at NAAS Brown Field, California.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 1 September – 1 October 1944 : The squadron was reformed at NAAS Brown Field , California

events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 October 1944 , VP-72 was redesignated VPB-122 .

events.text: Six of the seven VPB-122 crews were reassigned to VPB-108.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: - 30 November 1944 : Six of the seven VPB-122 crews were reassigned to VPB-108

events.text: Replacement crews brought the squadron back up to strength.
events.subject: self
events.quote: until replacement crews brought it back up to strength in early March 1945 .

events.text: VPB-122 was relocated to NAAS Crows Landing, California.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 15 March 1945 : VPB-122 was relocated to NAAS Crows Landing , California

events.subject: self
events.quote: Training was completed by the end of May 1945 .

events.text: The squadron was transferred to Ault Field, NAS Whidbey Island, Washington.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 1 June 1945 : The squadron was transferred to Ault Field , NAS Whidbey Island , Washington

events.subject: self
events.quote: New PB4Y-2s were received in July .

events.text: VPB-122 deployed to Shemya Air Force Base, Aleutians.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 5 August 1945 : VPB-122 deployed to Shemya Air Force Base , Aleutians

events.text: VPB-122 was temporarily based at Casco Field, Attu Island.
events.subject: self
events.quote: - 1 October 1945 : VPB-122 was temporarily based at Casco Field , Attu Island
